# Kivo

Kivo is a powerful SaaS tool that lets you tell your computer simply what to do.
It automates the boring stuff so you can do the creative stuff.

- **Open source repo:** https://github.com/PRODHOSH/kivo
- **Website:** https://kivo.prodhosh.me
- **Download:** Available for Windows at https://kivo.prodhosh.me/kivo-setup.exe

Contact us to team up or bring your ideas to life!
